findings.issue: afterNavigate clears `typed` unconditionally, so characters typed while a debounced search navigation is still in flight are wiped from the input when it settles; the debounce timer is also never cancelled, so a pending goto can navigate away after the user clicks a Pokémon card.
findings.suggestion: Cancel the timer in an $effect cleanup (or onDestroy), and only reset `typed` when it matches the settled `data.q` (or track the value the pending goto was built from).

findings.issue: spriteFor fabricates /media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png when the API returns null front_default, contradicting the spec's 'null means the set isn't shipped' contract — the fallback may 404 and render a broken image.
findings.suggestion: Return null when the API says null and render a text/placeholder element in PokemonCard.

findings.issue: The cache stores resolved data, not promises, so concurrent requests for the same URL within one load (e.g. /type/fire from getTypes() and the type filter) each fetch over HTTP.
findings.suggestion: Cache the in-flight promise (cache.set(url, promise) before awaiting) so parallel calls dedupe.

findings.issue: For non-404 errors the title is 'Error – Pokédex' while the h1 is 'Something went wrong'; the spec requires the title to mirror the h1.
findings.suggestion: Use 'Something went wrong – Pokédex' in the non-404 branch.

findings.issue: No '#lib' subpath-import alias, so all route files use deep relative chains like ../../../lib/utils.js — the exact thing SvelteKit 3's #lib alias (package.json imports field) was introduced to avoid.
findings.suggestion: Add "imports": { "#lib/*": "./src/lib/*" } and switch routes to #lib/server/... imports.

findings.issue: The augment callback receives an index into a parallel array (ability.pokemon), and the ability load then reads entries[index].is_hidden — a subtle, undocumented coupling that breaks silently if refs are filtered or reordered.
findings.suggestion: Pass the original entry itself (or a Map from ref url to entry) instead of relying on index alignment.

findings.issue: {#key data.selectedGame} unmounts and re-creates every MoveTable on game change; the official skill warns #key is expensive and unnecessary when child state is derived from props.
findings.suggestion: Drop the #key block — the tables' rows are already $derived from the new table data.

findings.issue: The default sort key expression (sortOverride ?? (hasLevel ? 'level' : 'move')) is duplicated in both the sortKey derived and the rows $derived.by, and sortOverride never resets back to the default order.
findings.suggestion: Reuse `sortKey` inside the rows derived and clear sortOverride when the user re-clicks the active default column.

findings.issue: Component-specific styles (.pokemon-card, .hidden-note) live in the global stylesheet while sibling components use scoped <style> blocks, splitting ownership across two places and risking class-name collisions.
findings.suggestion: Move .pokemon-card styles into PokemonCard.svelte's scoped <style>, keeping only genuinely shared primitives (.pill, tokens) global.

summary: A genuinely current, well-structured SvelteKit 3 app: new plugin-based config, $app/state, runes, snippets, clean lib/server boundaries and a small component set — most of it reads like the framework's own docs. The blocking items are localized: a real keystroke-loss race in the home-page search (afterNavigate clearing typed mid-navigation, uncancelled debounce timer) and a sprite fallback that fabricates URLs the spec says should stay null. I'd merge after one focused round fixing those, with the rest as nits.
